answer: Ephemeral Task Lattice. Each agent must solve a freshly generated spatial puzzle whose solution is a unique onyx-shaped path through a randomized grid; answers are accepted once and then discarded, so repeating a prior response fails. A lantern challenge seeds the next puzzle from the prior answer's hash, forming a spiral of dependent rounds. An attacker pays one GPU-minute per identity per round and cannot amortize solutions across clones, since copying yields stale hashes.
